text:
ara: Quick sync — can owners confirm mesh egress paths for ACME's private deploy? Blockers we know: customer firewall only allows outbound to port 443, and their NAT is sticky. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321
mike: I'm owner for routing. I pushed a draft patch to the staging routing table yesterday. Needs firewall rules from ops. @jen_ops can you confirm which IP ranges we can request?
sophia: From app side, we need to ensure prefix caching works when connection is proxied. Saw 502s in logs when we forced HTTPS termination at the customer LB.
jen_ops: ACME infra will only open 3 /24s to our egress LB. They gave: `198.51.100.0/24`, `198.51.101.0/24`, `198.51.102.0/24`. They also require TLS1.3 only. I'll ask them for a maintenance window.
jason: For air-gapped lane, is there an on-prem relay we can stage in their DMZ? We discussed a relay appliance last week. That would avoid inbound exceptions.
ara: Good point. @jason can you confirm relay sizing? We need peak RPS numbers for capacity planning.
jason: Relay sizing: estimate 300 tps at peak, burst 800. Needs 4 vCPU, 16GB RAM, and local SSD for cache. I'll put numbers in the ticket.
mike: Firewall rules needed from ACME: outbound to our egress LB on 443 and port 9411 for tracing; also allow NTP. Sample iptables snippet they can apply:
```
-A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 203.0.113.45 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 203.0.113.45 --dport 9411 -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 123 -j ACCEPT
```
sophia: Also, note that we can't use aggressive KV caching with sticky NAT — evictions happen frequently. Recommend caching TTL=30s for now.
jen_ops: ACME asked for a timeboxed rollback plan. Proposed: if errors exceed 5% for 10m, revert to internal routing. @deploy-bot can we add an automatic rollback trigger in canary config?
deploy-bot: Canary configured: rollback_on_error_rate=0.05 window=600s. Next canary run scheduled 2026-04-02T22:00Z.
ara: Thanks. Action items: 1) @jen_ops confirm maintenance window + IPs (jen_ops) 2) @jason post relay sizing to INF-4321 (jason) 3) @mike finalize routing CR and ping network review (mike) 4) @sophia set caching TTL and add test to smoke suite (sophia). I'll follow up EOD.
mike: Pinged @network-reviewers for CR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789
sophia: I'll add a quick smoke that simulates sticky NAT in staging.
jen_ops: Maintenance window request sent to ACME — waiting confirmation. I'll update when they ACK. :thumbsup:
ara: great, leaving this thread open for async updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
